description: Source code for repository information and structure commands in a Git implementation, including functions for retrieving repository properties, counting references and objects, and printing repository structure details.

methods.name: get_layout_bare
methods.description: Retrieves whether the repository is bare.

methods.name: get_layout_shallow
methods.description: Checks if the repository is shallow.

methods.name: get_object_format
methods.description: Gets the object format name used in the repository.

methods.name: get_references_format
methods.description: Gets the reference storage format name.

methods.name: print_field
methods.description: Prints a key-value pair in specified format.

methods.name: print_fields
methods.description: Prints specified keys and their values from the repository.

methods.name: cmd_repo_info
methods.description: Handles the 'repo info' command, printing repository properties.

methods.name: cmd_repo_structure
methods.description: Handles the 'repo structure' command, printing repository structure details.
